title: Setup → Permission Sets: the platform's built-in sets show no description (admin_full_access, organization_admin, member_default, viewer_readonly, external default), and the MCP / no-bypass ones are written for engineers
body:
Filing gate **① a user-visible defect with a named landing site**. Split from objectstack-ai/hotcrm#2294, whose HotCRM half (one-sentence descriptions on the eight app-declared sets) is in objectstack-ai/hotcrm#2303; the platform-declared sets are not HotCRM's to change.

## What is seen

Setup → Access Control → Permission Sets lists the platform's built-in sets beside every app's own. On the 2026-10-25 browser pass (`@objectstack/*` 18.1.0, zh-CN) `admin_full_access`, `organization_admin` and the other built-ins show 「—」 in the description column, while `organization_admin_no_bypass` shows a five-line description: [t12-权限集.png](https://github.com/objectstack-ai/hotcrm/blob/03c2ad1573fb93cf1318ab50ae22f9ba770c4166/qa/2026-10-25-browser-pass/shots/t12-权限集.png). An administrator picking a set for a new user (the Create User dialog offers one) cannot tell from the list what an administrator set opens that a member set does not.

## Readings (objectstack `origin/main` `59d9181ed5`)

`packages/plugins/plugin-security/src/objects/default-permission-sets.ts`:

| set | label | description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `admin_full_access` | Administrator — Full Access | none |
| `organization_admin` | Organization Administrator | none |
| `member_default` | Member — Standard Access | none |
| `viewer_readonly` | Viewer — Read-Only | none |
| `EXTERNAL_DEFAULT_PERMISSION_SET` | External Member — Own Records | none |
| `organization_admin_no_bypass` | Organization Administrator (no record bypass) | five sentences, names ADR posture terms and `admin_full_access` |
| `MCP_AGENT_PERMISSION_SET_READ` / `_WRITE` / `_RESTRICTED` | MCP Agent — … | two or three sentences each, written for engineers (OAuth scope names, "fails CLOSED", "better-auth managed") |

## Business reason

The permission-set list is where an administrator decides who can see and change what. Five of the platform's own sets give no help there, and the ones that do speak to platform engineers rather than to the administrator choosing a set. Every app on the platform inherits this list, so each app's descriptions sit beside blanks.

## Landing and reader

- Reader: the security / `plugin-security` owner, at first touch after triage.
- `default-permission-sets.ts`: one plain sentence per built-in set saying who holds it and what it opens or withholds (style: objectstack-ai/hotcrm#2303, one sentence, at most 160 characters). Engineering detail stays in the code comments beside each set, where it already partly lives.
- A test beside it that every set in `defaultPermissionSets` carries a one-sentence `description`.
- Translation of these sentences rides the permission-set bundle key from #25652; not in scope here.

## Done when

Every built-in set shows one business sentence in Setup → Permission Sets on a console built from the fix, and the pin holds.

Dedupe: REST list of objectstack issues (open and closed, 529 newest) grepped locally for `permission set description`, `permission-set description`, `default-permission-sets`, `admin_full_access` + `description` → 0 matching cards; related but distinct: #25652 (bundle key for position / permission-set translations), #25701, #25909. `reach:` the public UI, Setup → Permission Sets on every deployment.

Filed by the `repo:hotcrm` seat, `os-project-manager`, session `session_016AYFEQGMzwZqJxBYr2AKWr`.
